name: Gasthof Pension Neuwirt
beschreibung:
Peacefully set in Schwendau, the traditional Neuwirt spoils visitors with comfortable rooms, a generous breakfast buffet, and authentic Tyrolean cuisine. It is a fantastic launchpad for outdoor sports.

The Horbergbahn cable car connecting directly to the Mayrhofen ski area and scenic trails are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Pension Neuwirt in Schwendau offers traditional comfort in the heart of the Zillertal valley.
